Cedric Blanc is a reliable and forward-thinking professional whose technical rigor and collaborative spirit consistently elevate team performance. As a Staff ML Engineer at NeuraLogic Consulting, he bridges complex technical challenges with practical business outcomes, delivering solutions that align with client needs while advancing cutting-edge AI practices.  

Cedric’s work spans cloud infrastructure and machine learning systems. He led the migration of a client’s NLP pipeline to AWS, achieving a 35% reduction in latency through optimized EC2 instances and auto-scaling. His expertise in LLMs and prompt engineering enabled a financial services client to refine chatbot responses, boosting user satisfaction by 22% within six months. He also designed a Kubernetes-based MLOps pipeline using Terraform, streamlining model deployment and reducing operational overhead by 40%.  

Beyond technical skills, Cedric’s adaptability and curiosity drive continuous improvement. He proactively integrates tools like PyTorch and TensorFlow to tailor solutions, often mentoring junior engineers on best practices. His ability to distill complex concepts into actionable strategies makes him a valuable collaborator.  

Cedric’s work ethic is marked by reliability and intellectual honesty. He approaches challenges with methodical precision, balancing innovation with operational stability. I am confident he will contribute meaningfully to any organization fortunate enough to welcome him.
